```{r setup}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(cli)
devtools::load_all(quiet = TRUE)
```

# Check data

## Stiff fin no flow case

```{r siff fin no flow}
stiff_fin_noflow <- read_flapper_dataset('RawData/ForceData/2026-11-03/StiffFin',
                                         fin = 'stiff', trialtype = 'noflow',
                                         cutoff = 5,
                                         trials = seq(2, 100))


nanoparquet::write_parquet(stiff_fin_noflow, proj_path("processed_dir", 'stiff_fin_noflow_data.parquet'))
```

## Flexible fin no flow case

```{r flex fin no flow}
flex_fin_noflow <- read_flapper_dataset('RawData/ForceData/2026-11-03/FlexFin',
                                         fin = 'flexible', trialtype = 'noflow',
                                         cutoff = 5,
                                         trials = seq(4, 34))


nanoparquet::write_parquet(flex_fin_noflow, proj_path("processed_dir", 'flex_fin_noflow_data.parquet'))
```

## Stiff fin self-propelled speed case

```{r stiff fin sps}
stiff_fin_sps <- read_flapper_dataset('RawData/ForceData/2026-11-10/StiffFin',
                                         fin = 'stiff', trialtype = 'sps')
nanoparquet::write_parquet(stiff_fin_sps, proj_path("processed_dir", 'stiff_fin_sps_data.parquet'))
```


